caption: The drawing depicts a series of twelve different hand tools arranged in a semi-circular, fan-like formation, with their handles pointing outward and upward. All the tools are rendered in a consistent brownish-yellow color, resembling wood or a uniform sepia tone. The objects include various types of axes, hammers, picks, a handsaw, and other tools with distinct functional shapes such as blades, hooks, and mallets. Beneath the row of upright tools, there is a long, slender rod-like object with a hooked end, placed horizontally across the bottom of the composition. The background is plain, off-white or beige, with no additional decoration or markings. The drawing places emphasis on the form and structure of each tool, highlighting their individual shapes through even, flat coloration and clear outlines.
title: Jack Straws
